{{Quote|Red One will drop into an Imperial Training Area in the Senex System.|[[Jan Dodonna/Legends|Jan Dodonna]]|<ref name="XW" />}}
The '''Senex system''' was a [[Star system/Legends|star system]] located within the [[Senex sector/Legends|Senex sector]] of the [[Mid Rim/Legends|Mid Rim]] and [[Western Reaches/Legends|Western Reaches]] regions of [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]] that contained the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Senex/Legends|Senex]].<ref name="TEA" />

==History==
During the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], it hosted an [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] training ground. While training, [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]] pilot recruit [[Dev]] accidentally [[Hyperspace/Legends|hyperspaced]] to Senex system. Mistaking the training craft for exercise targets, he [[Raid in the Senex system|wiped them out]] before his [[Astromech droid/Legends|astromech]] notified him he was in Imperial space. This event was ported into a simulated exercise for Rebel pilots.<ref name="XW" />
